title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: This article reports on the wide political and media impact of Fabio Giglietto’s study, 'A Pretty Blunt Approach.' Following Giglietto's findings on algorithmic suppression of mainstream political speech, the issue was highlighted on Rai3's investigative program Report and prompted a formal inquiry inside the European Parliament.
description: An article reporting on the wide political and media impact of Fabio Giglietto's study from the University of Urbino regarding Meta's algorithmic suppression of mainstream political speech.

title: Social media, l'Agcom avvia verifiche con la Commissione Ue sugli algoritmi di Meta. Focus sui contenuti politici
snippet: This news article reports on Italy's Communications Regulatory Authority (Agcom) initiating a formal probe in coordination with the EU Commission to investigate Meta's moderation algorithms. The decision was prompted by the findings of a study coordinated by Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino, which criticized the opacity and biased effects of Meta's recommendation systems.
description: An Italian news article reporting on Agcom's regulatory probe into Meta's algorithms, which was prompted by a study on algorithmic opacity coordinated by Fabio Giglietto.

title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: An article published on Lumsanews highlighting Giglietto's investigation of Facebook's feed algorithms. It outlines the specific figures from the study, revealing how mainstream politicians lost massive ground in user visibility compared to anti-establishment and vaccine-skeptic pages that grew their reach via increased posting volume.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.
